canvas.$description: White: the page, white sections and cards (through surface-page and surface-card).

paper.$description: Cool off-white: the footer, the FAQ toggle, nav link hover, small fills inside cards.

smoke.$description: Disabled states and skeleton lines. Not used on the current pages.

ash.$description: Decorative marks only (3.1:1 on white), never text. Not used on the current pages.

slate.$description: The body text colour (through text-body): paragraphs, leads, captions, FAQ answers. 6.3:1 on white.

charcoal.$description: Strong neutral. Not used on the current pages.

plum-velvet.$description: Deep plum (through text-strong): nav links, footer links and the default h3. 13.8:1 on white.

mist-violet.$description: Lavender tint: the start of the hero wash, pill tags, the active nav link, the open FAQ toggle, problem cards, the Kinage comparison card.

lavender-glow.$description: Lavender glow inside the purple banner, together with peach. Decoration only.

ink.$description: The heading colour (through text-heading): h1, h2 and card titles. 17:1 on white.

eggplant.$description: Kinage purple: the textured banner, purple bands, the skip link, the browser theme colour. White text on it is 8.7:1.

eggplant-deep.$description: Darker purple for pressed states on purple. Not used on the current pages.

amethyst.$description: Links, text links, the focus ring and the active nav link text. 9.5:1 on white.

peach.$description: Warm decorative accent: the banner glow and the How it works progress line. Never text.

peach-soft.$description: Warm tint behind warm tags and icon tiles.

peach-ink.$description: Warm accent for text and icons. 6.4:1 on white.

product-ink.$description: Text inside product screen illustrations only.

product-muted.$description: Secondary text inside product screen illustrations only.

product-canvas.$description: Background of product screen illustrations only.

product-border.$description: Card border inside product screen illustrations only.

product-violet.$description: Action colour inside product screen illustrations only.

overdue-bg.$description: Overdue status badge background in product illustrations.

overdue-ink.$description: Overdue status badge text in product illustrations.

flag-bg.$description: Flagged status badge background in product illustrations.

flag-ink.$description: Flagged status badge text in product illustrations.

white.$description: White text and surfaces on purple, white buttons on the banner.

lilac.$description: Pale lilac: the dialog close button and soft fills.

orchid.$description: Soft orchid: the dialog close button on hover, the video progress bar and captions toggle.

violet.$description: Same value as amethyst: the form field focus border and halo.

night.$description: Backdrop of the video player in full screen.

berry.$description: Form errors: the field border, the error text and the alert tint. 7:1 on white.

mandarin.$description: Primary button fill, always with a white label (3.4:1). Never use mandarin for text.

mandarin-hover.$description: Primary button on hover: a touch lighter, white label.

mandarin-active.$description: Primary button when pressed: a touch deeper, white label.

mandarin-label.$description: Label and icons on mandarin buttons, in every state.

mandarin-ink.$description: Outlined button label and the focus ring of mandarin buttons. 5.8:1 on white.

mandarin-tint.$description: Outlined button background on hover (its label is 5.3:1 on it).

text-heading.$description: Headings: h1, h2 and card titles.

text-strong.$description: The default h3, nav links and footer links.

text-body.$description: The one body text colour: every paragraph, lead, caption and FAQ answer.

text-muted.$description: Same as text-body: there is no lighter text colour.

text-accent.$description: Purple emphasis for a short run of body text outside headings (a bold label, a figure). Never a coloured part of a heading.

text-warm.$description: Text on warm tags and warm icon tiles.

text-on-brand.$description: Headings and text on the purple banner and purple bands.

text-on-brand-soft.$description: Leads and secondary text on purple (6.2:1).

text-on-brand-faint.$description: Faint text on purple. Not used on the current pages.

surface-brand.$description: The purple banner and purple bands.

border-hairline.$description: 1px dividers: FAQ rows, footer rules, comparison rows.

display.$value: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
display.$description: Plus Jakarta Sans 500: headings only (h1 to h3, card titles, banner headlines, the footer tagline, the person caption name).

text.$description: DM Sans 400 to 700: everything that is not a heading (body, buttons, nav, labels, FAQ, forms, footer).

product.$description: Museo Sans: only inside the product screen illustrations, never for page content.

black.$description: Same as bold: no weight above 700 is used on the page.

caps.$description: Uppercase labels (footer column titles, the video label).

display.$description: Hero headline (h1). Hero.css scales it with the hero card, 38px at the smallest.

heading-xl.$description: Page titles (h1) on inner pages and large section headings.

title.$description: Card and step titles (h3) in the heading face.

title-sm.$description: Small titles: 20px card titles, the footer tagline, h4 in documents (in the text face, 600).

lead.$description: Hero lead and large intro text.

body-relaxed.$description: Section leads, story text and document paragraphs.

body-sm.$description: Small text: card body, captions under photos.

button.$description: Buttons: every variant (filled, outlined and on purple).

button-sm.$description: Small buttons and form labels (labels use weight 700).

container.$description: Page max width. Content sits in .container: this width minus the gutters.

container-narrow.$description: Reading column: section heads, text pages (about 70 characters a line at 18px).

nav-height.$description: Height of the fixed nav bar.

nav-offset.$description: Gap above the fixed nav bar. Page tops clear nav-offset + nav-height + 32px.

nav-width.$description: Max width of the nav bar.

section-space.$description: Section padding (top and bottom) from 1200px up.

section-join.$description: Top padding of a section that continues the band above it (40px under 768px).

hero-tail.$description: Hero stage colour below the hero card, desktop; taken out of the problem section’s top padding so the card-to-heading distance stays the section rhythm.

sm.$description: Inputs, chips, small badges, video controls, focus outline of text links.

md.$description: Buttons, the nav bar, alerts, small tiles, the default focus outline.

lg.$description: Content cards: problem and comparison cards, How it works step tabs, advisor cards, .surface-card.

xl.$description: Large containers: the hero card, banners, the Ben and Our Story cards, the How it works panel, dialogs, the video.

pill.$description: Pill tags, nav links, the FAQ toggle and round marks only. Do not add new pill shapes.

sm.$description: Soft and low: the primary button, small tiles and member cards.

md.$description: Soft and wide: .surface-card, the nav bar, comparison cards, How it works steps, the video.

lg.$description: Soft and widest: large containers (the hero card, the Ben and Our Story cards, dialogs).

reveal.$description: Section reveals and the dialog entrance.

out.$description: Calm deceleration for every entrance and hover; GSAP 'kinage.out'.

reveal-start.$description: A section reveals when its top reaches 85% of the viewport height.

demo-start.$description: Product demos start when their top reaches 75% of the viewport height.

idle.$description: ms of no scrolling before a hidden nav returns.

hide.$description: The nav lifting away while the page scrolls.

show.$description: The nav returning after scrolling stops.

distance.$description: How far the nav lifts when it hides.

duration.$description: Wheel smoothing (Lenis): time for each wheel step to glide to rest.

ease.$description: GSAP ease of the wheel glide (ease-out cubic): it reaches the target exactly at the end of the duration, with no final snap and no overshoot.

min-width.$description: Wheel smoothing runs from this width (px), with a fine pointer and motion allowed.

scrub.$description: Seconds the hero objects take to settle after a native scroll stops.

end.$description: The flight completes when the centre of the problem-card row reaches 58% of the viewport height.

spread.$description: Per-asset offset of start/end within the scrubbed timeline so the six objects do not move in lockstep.

shadow-in.$description: Timeline progress at which the cards’ contact shadows begin to fade in.

min-width.$description: Viewport width (px) at and above which the shared-element flight runs.

period.$description: Seconds per full turn of the dotted hero rings (linear, seamless loop).

ramp.$description: Seconds to ease the rings to rest when the hero leaves view or the tab is hidden, and back.

hold.$description: Milliseconds the How it works step holds its end state before its animation replays (loops while the step is active).

mobile.$description: Phone width the layout is designed at. Phone rules use max-width: 767px.

tablet.$description: Tablet layout from 768px (max-width: 1023px for tablet rules).

desktop.$description: Desktop width the layout is designed at.
